mainEntity.name: How does UniDoxia help me apply to universities?

acceptedAnswer.text: UniDoxia connects you with verified agents who guide you through every stage — from selecting universities to submitting documents.

mainEntity.name: Is there a fee to use the platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: Creating an account and exploring universities is free. Agents may charge consulting fees, clearly shown before commitment.

mainEntity.name: What documents do I need to apply?

acceptedAnswer.text: Academic transcripts, English test scores (IELTS/TOEFL), recommendations, personal statement, and passport copy are typically required.

mainEntity.name: Can I apply to multiple universities?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! You can apply to multiple universities at once and track all applications in one dashboard.

mainEntity.name: How do I stay informed about my application status?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your personalized dashboard shows real-time updates, deadlines, and next steps so you always know what to do next.

mainEntity.name: How can our university partner with UniDoxia?

acceptedAnswer.text: Submit a partnership enquiry or contact our team. Any formal relationship proceeds only after appropriate checks, agreed responsibilities and a written agreement.
Universities gain access to dashboards showing applicant pipelines, conversion metrics, and regional interest so you can plan recruitment campaigns with confidence.

mainEntity.name: Can we manage offers directly on the platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Admissions teams can issue conditional or unconditional offers, request missing documents, and communicate with students and agents from a single workspace.

mainEntity.name: What support do agents receive on UniDoxia?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agents receive a dedicated CRM, marketing collateral, and on-demand training to help match students with suitable courses quickly.
Commission structures are transparent. Universities define the terms, and payouts are tracked within the agent dashboard for easy reconciliation.

mainEntity.name: Can agents collaborate with university admissions teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Shared workspaces and messaging threads keep all parties aligned on student progress, missing documents, and interview scheduling.
